## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach taken.

## Testing

List the commands, Python versions, wheel or source-build platforms, and environments used to
verify the change.

## Hardware

State whether hardware testing was performed. If so, identify the sensor model and relevant
firmware or configuration without including credentials, sensor addresses, host addresses, or
private network details.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were added or updated for behavior changes.
- [ ] `pixi run check` and relevant integration tests pass.
- [ ] Public API or behavior changes are documented.
- [ ] Supported Python versions and Linux wheel platforms were considered.
- [ ] Hardware tests were explicitly opted into and performed safely, or were not required.
- [ ] Changes intended for `ros-netft` include a documented manual backport plan.
